title: Resolve upstream integration conflicts without silently losing fork changes
abstract: When an authorized fork integration produces competing edits, identify the affected fork-specific patches and upstream changes, choose an explicit resolution supported by the approved task, and verify that intended behavior is preserved; never treat an automatic merge or rebase result as authorization to discard a local customization.

scope_hints.scope_boundary: Only separately authorized work on an existing Rust fork and its explicitly identified upstream; neither queueing nor this proposed requirement authorizes repository edits, upstream integrations, releases, or unrelated work.

remarks: Normalized and published as NOM-0132; no rule application or unrelated repository action.
